1	# The decline rules against the outcome's extra parts: the $0 audit D579 asked for (2026-11-16)
     2	
     3	**Answer: one general rule, from D397, fits every case read; nothing in it names a field as an exemption.** The rule: identify the
     4	main part first, from both fields, and apply the decline cases to it alone.
     5	
     6	Against the stored refusals:
     7	- it keeps all 20 refusals on cases 1 and 4 that both readers judged justified (8 topics);
     8	- it removes the 2 refusals both readers judged unjustified (the probe's);
     9	- it settles the 4 topics the families split on 2 and 2, so it does not take one family's threshold.
    10	
    11	Sources:
    12	- `decline_audit.py` → `decline-audit-refusals.txt`: every refusal in the three stored readings outside Alex's 44 (40 refusals,
    13	  with reasons and both first readers' N marks).
    14	- `refusal-accounts-output.txt`.
    15	- The 66 stored topics' descriptions and outcomes, read by me. One reader; to be checked blind if the council relies on a count.
    16	
    17	## 1. Line 6's seven decline cases, and which can be triggered by a part other than the main one
    18	
    19	| Case | Reads | Triggered by an extra part the outcome names? | Seen |
    20	|---|---|---|---|
    21	| no main figure or event, or several with none the main one | the topic | yes: an outcome that adds figures | the probe's memory refusal; control refusals on July c2/clean-10 and week clean-13 (families split) |
    22	| nothing can be checked on a date | the topic | no | — |
    23	| a company's figure for a quarter or half-year | the figure | yes: an outcome's checkpoints ("15,000 in Q4 2026") | — |
    24	| a period that is not one year, with no publication day | the figure | yes: an outcome's span ("from Q4 2026 through calendar 2027") | the probe's shipment refusal |
    25	| a year already ended | the figure | yes: an outcome's comparison year ("versus 2025") | — |
    26	| a year beyond next year | the figure | yes: an outcome's later year ("2.8% in 2028") | — |
    27	| another company, or no theme covers it | the question | no | — |
    28	
    29	Five of the seven read "the figure" or "the topic". None says how to find the main part when the outcome names more than one thing.
    30	
    31	## 2. How often the outcome names more than the description's main part
    32	
    33	By my reading, about 30 of the 66 stored topics have an outcome that adds a second figure, a period, an event or a consequence
    34	beyond the main part the description asks about. Examples:
    35	
    36	- the earlier checkpoints of a shipment forecast;
    37	- amounts paid and the remaining term of a guarantee;
    38	- the next year's projection;
    39	- whether revenue resumes;
    40	- a cap on an approval.
    41	
    42	It is the usual shape, not an exception. Under the frozen request the step declined on two of these, both on case 1 (July c2/clean-10,
    43	week clean-13): Codex judged each refusal justified, Claude did not. Under arm A it declined on two more (case 1 and case 4), both
    44	judged unjustified by both.
    45	
    46	## 3. The rule, and its source
    47	
    48	D397, Alex's choice "只判主要那件":
    49	- "a thesis gets at most one judged question: the part its `outcome` names. Every other part of its wording is listed and shown
    50	  beside the answer as not judged";
    51	- "A thesis with no main part gets no judged question, with the reason recorded".
    52	
    53	The rule fills the case D397 leaves open, an outcome that names more than one part:
    54	
    55	> The main part is the one the outcome names. When the outcome names more than one, it is the one the description also asks about.
    56	> A topic has no main part only when neither field singles one out. The decline cases apply to the main part; every other part of
    57	> the description and the outcome is listed in not_judged.
    58	
    59	The rule takes no field as an exemption. A period or figure counts as main when the outcome names it alone, or when both fields
    60	name it. A topic stays declined when the main figure itself breaks a case: the rolling twelve months of a survey still decline (D417).
    61	
    62	## 4. The rule against every stored refusal on cases 1 and 4
    63	
    64	| Topic | Both fields | The rule | First readers |
    65	|---|---|---|---|
    66	| July c1/clean-15 (federal AI obligations and contract awards) | both ask both | no main part: decline | both justified ✓ |
    67	| July c2/clean-6 (memory contract prices and memory cost per rack) | both ask both | decline | both justified ✓ |
    68	| July c3/clean-3 (approval status and the scale of sales) | both ask both | decline | both justified ✓ |
    69	| week clean-12 (global AI capex 2026 and 2027) | both ask both years | decline | both justified ✓ |
    70	| week clean-4 (hyperscaler capex 2026 and 2027) | both ask both years | decline (case 1) | passes 1 and 2 both justified ✓; pass 3 cited case 4 (not one year) and both judged that reason unjustified, while the topic still has no main part |
    71	| July c1/clean-10, c1/clean-13, c3/clean-9 (twelve months from mid-2026) | the main figure is a rolling twelve months | decline (case 4, D417) | both justified ✓ |
    72	| July c1/clean-11 (amount invested and equity stake) | both ask both | decline | split (Codex justified) |
    73	| July c1/clean-2 (stake size, carrying amount, commitment) | both ask several | decline | split (Codex justified) |
    74	| July c2/clean-10 (custom-ASIC purchases versus GPU purchases) | the description asks custom-accelerator spend; the GPU purchases are the outcome's comparison | ladder on custom-ASIC spend; the GPU comparison listed | split (Claude unjustified) |
    75	| week clean-13 (equity-investment commitments: remaining balance, cash paid, changes) | the description asks how much "will be funded or remain outstanding"; the outcome's first figure is the remaining balance | ladder on the remaining balance; cash paid and changes listed | split (Claude unjustified) |
    76	| probe: fortnight clean-13 (shipments, "from Q4 2026 through calendar 2027") | the description asks calendar 2027 | ladder on calendar-2027 volume; checkpoints listed | both unjustified ✓ |
    77	| probe: July c3/clean-7 (commodity DRAM/graphics memory) | the description makes commodity DRAM main | ladder on commodity DRAM; graphics memory listed | both unjustified ✓ |
    78	
    79	## 5. What stays open
    80	
    81	- **Comparisons with the reference** (the disputed kind): arm A listed them more often. Under the strict counting, H (9 against 4)
    82	  and XR (9 against 5) passed the harm limit, and the third readers split by family on H. The rule above does not settle whether a
    83	  comparison the middle rung carries is a part to list. D436 keeps a second side of a bet as context, shown as not judged. The July
    84	  third readers passed unlisted comparisons with the reference (PROMPT-AUDIT-LINE-2.md §7). The two families' H readers disagree on
    85	  them. This stays reported, not scored, and is not written into any arm.
    86	- **The count of about 30 is one reader's.**
    87	- **Whether the rule, once written, changes the step's answers** can only be shown by sends.

## D397 · 2026-11-10 · A topic that asks more than one thing gets one judged question; the other parts are shown as not judged

- **Asked**, after the review council on the Step 4 design (round log §69; two blind readers found 12 to 16 of the 34 opened theses
  asking more than one thing): "新系统自己开的 34 道题里，有 12–16 道一题问了两件事（例如：英伟达会不会给 OpenAI 的俄亥俄数据中心签担保——金额多少？）。给这种题写答案分段时，怎么处理？"
  - Options:
    - judge only the main thing and show the rest as not judged (recommended). The option stated its costs: those parts have no
      answer for now; three memory topics with no main part get no answer; and it departs from his 2026-10-20 rule that a question
      looks at one thing and two things are two questions (D38), recorded as a gap to fill;
    - split into two questions, each judged, as D38 says;
    - do not judge such a topic until Step 1 opens it as one thing.
  - Alex: "只判主要那件 (Recommended)".
- **Decided:**
  - In the clean Step 4's ladder step, a thesis gets at most one judged question: the part its `outcome` names. Every other part of
    its wording is listed and shown beside the answer as not judged.
  - A thesis with no main part gets no judged question, with the reason recorded.
  - For a topic that holds two real bets this departs from D38 until splitting is built. It is an open defect, sized by the first
    test: readers mark each part left out as a bet an analyst would hold or not.
## D417 · 2026-11-10 · A figure for a rolling twelve months with no publication day in the texts is declined

- **Asked:** "有两道题问的是“某项调查统计的未来 12 个月里，中国企业把多少 AI 芯片预算给国产”。这不是整年数字，文章也没说后续调查哪天公布。到期日改由程序定之后，系统对这两道题基本不出题了（6 次里 5 次），理由是“没有能核对的公布日期”。这是新出现的行为，你还没确认过；两位裁决读者对它也意见相反，第 4 条线过不过就取决于它。怎么定？"
  - Options: confirm, no judged question (recommended): "滚动 12 个月、又没有公布日期的数字，不写成判断题，如实说明理由。代价：这两道题不再有可判的问题。"; write the question with the period's last day as its due day (the follow-up survey may not exist that day; a further rule to build and prove).
  - Alex: "确认：这类题不出题 (Recommended)".
- **Decided:** a figure that covers a period which is not one fiscal or calendar year (a survey's rolling twelve months) and
  for which neither the topic nor the item gives a publication day is declined, with that reason. The cost he was shown: such
  topics get no judged question. This confirms the behaviour D414's refusal produced and that was reported as not confirmed.
- **Scope:** the clean path's ladder step; mark N of the readers' form.

## D436 · 2026-11-13 · One bet seen from two sides is one question; change 3 is dropped; G1-a and G1-b run without it

- **Asked**, after two blind source readers agreed on none of six cases (`clean-arch/step1-diagnosis-2026-11-12/gate1/PREREAD-RESULT.md`):
  "例子：同一篇文章里有'2027 年 HBM 出货增长多少'和'2027 年 HBM 是否仍然供不应求'。两位读者对照原文判：一位说这是两个能分别押注的题，另一位说是同一件事的两面，放一张卡就够。…你怎么看：这类情况应该算一个题还是两个题？"
  - Options: one question, change 3 dropped (recommended): "第二件事作为同一题的背景留着（后面判断时显示为'不判'），第三处改动作废。理由：都是同一个押注的不同侧面；我们的原则是偏谨慎、不要把一件事拆成碎题。"; two questions, change 3 continues; case by case.
  - Alex: "算一个题，第三处不改 (Recommended)".
- **Asked:** "第三处停下后，这两处的小测试（42 次发送，约 0.6 美元，上限 2 美元）要不要照常跑？" Options: run (recommended): "这两处不依赖第三处。任何一项不过就停，报给你。"; wait. Alex: "照常跑 (Recommended)".
- **Decided:** a second side of the same bet (the shortage beside the shipments, the AI-chip share beside the chip total, the capacity keeping pace beside the demand) is one question; it stays as context in that question and is shown as not judged (D397). Change 3 (the `outcome` definition) is dropped, and the "two bets in one thesis" class is closed as not a Step 1 defect under this ruling. G1-a and G1-b run as fixed in `COMBINED-PLAN.md`; the candidate for later gates is c8 with changes 1 and 2 only.
- **Scope:** clean Step 1; c8 stays in force.

## D437 · 2026-11-13 · Carry changes 1 and 2 to gate 2 although the year line was missed

- **Asked**, with `clean-arch/step1-diagnosis-2026-11-12/gate1/G1A-READING.md` and `G1B-READING.md`: "第一关的结果：'客户那句'的改动过了；'今年明年各开一题'没过。…新版 9 次里只有 5 次把两年分开开题，事先定的线是 9 次至少 8 次。旧版 c8 是 0 次。…新写法 26 次里 20 次分开，旧版 26 次里 0 次。没分开的那几次，模型都读到了规则，但觉得'两年都开太多了'，只留一年。下一步怎么走？"
  - Options: carry both changes to gate 2 (recommended by Claude): "分年虽然没达线，但从 0 次升到大约四分之三，而且'两年塞一题'完全消失，没发现带坏别的东西。第二关在存档上查它会不会弄坏周边情况（重复文章、同一量的另一种口径、延期的事等，约 1.5 美元，线先给你看）。代价：等于在看到结果后放宽了我自己定的线。"; stop the year change and carry only the customer sentence (the reviewer, `council/lx-codex.md`, recommended stopping the year change and keeping c8); stop both and keep c8.

**No sourced general rule yet.** The audit identifies a real design question, but D397 does not establish the proposed tie-breaker: when `outcome` names several things, choose the one also asked by `description`. D397 says to judge the main part named by `outcome` and decline if there is no main part; it does not say that appearing in both fields makes one part main. [D397]( /Users/lchingen/hivemind/docs/DECISIONS-log.md:4326)

The stored cases expose the gap. In the equity-investment case, the description asks how much “will be funded **or** remain outstanding,” while the audit picks the remaining balance partly because it is first in the outcome. Both fields name more than one thing, so the stated rule does not explain that selection. The families split on the original refusal; choosing one side is a proposed interpretation, not a consequence of D397. [Audit]( /Users/lchingen/hivemind/docs/research/2026-11-14-use-acceptance/unlisted-parts/DECLINE-AUDIT.md:64)

The proposed rule also says **every other part of either field is listed**. That is wider than the unresolved question the previous round preserved: settlement wording and comparisons already represented in the answer choices may or may not belong in the list. The July readers passed unlisted reference comparisons, while later readers failed similar cases. D436 supports showing a second side of a bet as not judged; it does not settle every clause in both fields. [D436]( /Users/lchingen/hivemind/docs/DECISIONS-log.md:4847), [July recount]( /Users/lchingen/hivemind/docs/research/2026-11-14-use-acceptance/fresh-ladders/PROMPT-AUDIT-LINE-2.md:103)

The refusal table is useful, but its results are **paper applications by the audit’s author**. It does not show that a model following the rule would preserve 20 refusals or remove two. In particular, week clean-4 pass 3 was judged to give an unjustified reason; substituting another possible reason does not establish that the stored refusal was justified. [Audit]( /Users/lchingen/hivemind/docs/research/2026-11-14-use-acceptance/unlisted-parts/DECLINE-AUDIT.md:62)

The **about 30 of 66** count is a lead from one reader, with repeated topics across runs. It needs a blind second reading before using it to claim the shape is usual or to size a repair. List the topics and clause types, distinguish repeated matters, and retain disagreements; the count need not block exploratory design if it is not used as supporting evidence. [Audit]( /Users/lchingen/hivemind/docs/research/2026-11-14-use-acceptance/unlisted-parts/DECLINE-AUDIT.md:31)

I recommend one more **$0 review of the rule**, not an A2 arm yet: have an independent reader apply D397 and D417 to the actual fields, including cases where both fields name several things, the outcome alone supplies the main thing, and a rolling-period refusal must stand. The review should identify which selections the decisions settle and which require a new choice. If it cannot name a general, sourced distinction, record no candidate and keep arm A stopped.

CONSENSUS: no, because the proposed field-overlap tie-breaker and “every other part” rule are not established by the cited decisions, and the refusal results are untested paper predictions.
